title: pneumatopteris truncata
intro: Pneumatopteris truncata, commonly known as the Truncata fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta and is native to the tropical regions of Asia. Pneumatopteris truncata has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
